correctness.rationale: The diagonal-block quotient End(A)->product_j M_{m_j}(F_p) is surjective with fiber size p^(E-sum m_j^2), where E=sum_{j,l}m_j m_l min(e_j,e_l). Invertibility and additive translates are detected on that quotient. For m>=2, count fixed nonzero eigenvectors of C in GL_m: H=(sum_C #(nonzero v:Cv=v)), the identity adds p^m-p above the (p-1)b baseline, so each bad translate excludes strictly less than H/(p-1); k<=p-1 such translates cannot cover GL_m. For m=1, N_1=p-1-number_of_distinct_nonzero_scalar_obstructions. Uniform independent lifts induce independent uniform scalar coordinates; a singleton block obstructs at k=p-1 precisely when all p-1 values are distinct, of probability (p-1)!/(p-1)^(p-1). Multiply across r independent blocks and count constant-fiber lifts. At p=2, k=1 correctly makes r>0 success probability zero, while r=0 has success one. A direct independent enumeration of all 11,664 automorphism pairs of C3⊕C9 gave 2,916 successes, each with 27 witnesses, 8,748 failures. This finite calculation only corroborates the complete quotient/union-bound proof.
